laws.canonical_state: goal program bindings scopes context world time evidence authority result contract and every typed obligation are content-bound; a topic scalar cannot reconstruct guidance state
laws.projection: only unresolved obligations project typed queries and every projection retains obligation bindings and boundaries
laws.fold: raw evidence count and unique dependence roots are both retained; duplicate descendants sharing one root cannot multiply independent support
laws.transition: resolutions produce a new derived guidance state without rewriting the prior state or its evidence
laws.scheduler: hard target relevance preconditions authority and resource validity are checked before deterministic expected-obligation-reduction information-value and cost comparison; raw novelty cannot redirect an active goal
laws.operation: kind operands preconditions predicted obligation effects resource costs effect authority and receipt contract remain explicit and cannot be replaced by a scalar priority
laws.completion: every required obligation must be satisfied or hold a permitted typed unresolved disposition; endpoint arrival nonempty rows and minimum scalar cost cannot certify semantic completion
